title: Settings of the servitor, pattern Mark I
description: The servitor's standing orders, kept as servitor.json in the Librarium. A rune outranks the environment, the environment outranks these orders, and these orders outrank the defaults. Recite 'servitor expound <key>' for the lore of any key.

pattern.description: The Mark of the form in which these orders are written. This servitor reads only "Mark I"; orders of no pattern, or of another, are heresy and none of them is heeded.

tongue.description: The program in which incantations and litanies are spoken when neither their rite nor the step names one.

chronicle.description: Where the chronicle of every invocation is kept; a path that does not begin at the root is reckoned from the Librarium. The rune --chronicle and SERVITOR_CHRONICLE outrank it; $XDG_STATE_HOME/servitor/chronicle.jsonl when unwritten.

vox.description: Whether vox-casts reach the desktop through notify-send: "auto" sends there the tidings of an invocation roused without a terminal (a terminal hears the report instead), "notify-send" sends the tidings of every invocation, a terminal or none, "off" keeps the desktop silent (a terminal still hears the report).

patience.description: How long an incantation or litany may labour before it is slain and deemed fallen, unless the step says otherwise: a span greater than nothing, such as "500ms", "30s" or "2m".

$schema.description: The schema these orders are written against, for the editors of the faithful. The servitor accepts it and heeds it not.

word.description: Words that may not be empty, for the servitor cannot heed what names nothing.

patience.description: A span greater than nothing, as the old cogitators reckon it: numerals each followed by "ns", "us", "ms", "s", "m" or "h".
